results.statement: A Jev or LLM call failure must be retried up to three times before the slot reports failure; the failure reason must appear in the runs page severity table with an icon distinct from a JEV verdict that the work is not done; and no workflow class bead, outage bead, hold on re-dispatch, refusal citation or checker-defect side channel may exist in the sanity or refusal flows.
results.quote: this entire process of hold on re-dispatch sounds like a team trying to manage a reliable asset by making excuses not to deal with failures to call the agent properly.  (I suspect that a subagent sends too much context and jev returns error, instead of editing context, failure is returned.  There are occasionally LLM call fails during heavy traffic times which can be retried 3x before saying fail. )  Make sure that LLM failure reason shows up in severity table in tui AND the fail icon for typesafe API issue is distinctly different from jev answered 'all work NOT done'.  this `Class-bead append and citation on every refusal, and the checker-defect side channel.` also sounds like ceremony I did not know about or approve.
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18 (third round): Rand on the sanity runs table, Jev/LLM failures and refusal ceremony
